facts.fact: SAnews reports that access to identity information is regulated under, among others, the Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000.
facts.system: Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000

ZAF.note: Remote biometric identity confirmation is only proposed in draft regulations and no service is said to be authorised, contracted or piloted.
The document says nothing about records passing between the civil register and the ID system.
The document names a digital birth certificate credential only as a proposal and states no digital civil registration system.

facts.fact: SAnews reports that access to identity information is regulated under, among others, the Protection of Personal Information Act of 2013.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act of 2013

facts.fact: Home Affairs Minister Leon Schreiber gazetted draft amended regulations in terms of the Identification Act of 1997, open for comment until 6 June 2026, to create the framework for a digital identity system.

ZAF.note: The document only mentions the Digital Transformation Roadmap's goal and states nothing of its standing, text or reporting.
Comments on the draft regulations are invited by hand, post and e-mail, and the document does not say the draft was posted online.
The document gives no count or share of people holding a national ID.
The document says nothing about an ID number at birth.
The document says nothing about who operates or owns the ID system.
The document names no register keyed on the national ID number.

facts.fact: Minister Schreiber says technical work on the foundational Digital Identity system is well underway and that finalising the draft regulations will let Home Affairs deliver services on smartphones.
SAnews says the draft regulations are intended to strengthen the population register as the single authoritative record of identity and civic status information.

The Department of Home Affairs invited the public, civil society organisations, industry and other stakeholders to submit written comments by 6 June 2026 on its draft digital identity regulations under the Identification Act.
facts.system: Draft amended regulations under the Identification Act of 1997

ZAF.note: The document states no digital entry of births or deaths at civil registration offices.
